name: 日常面部保湿乳空槽卖点版式款
description: 白底拖尾主图开场，膏体质地递证，主张全改空槽，信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool silver-white #F1F3F6 graphic fields for information screens, cool grey #DCE1E5 studio backdrop for people screens, one broad soft arc band along the bottom edge as the only graphic device
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card, cool neutral tone, controlled low speculars, soft contact shadows only
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic #FFFFFF, pale light-stone counter #E9E4DE, pale marble ledge #EDEBE8, pale matte disc #F7F6F4
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all source wording stripped, headline and label areas remain blank bars reserved for copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight cobalt #1F6FB2 double-ring badges with blank centres plus solid cobalt check circles, never carrying legible text
styleLock.presentationRules: the tube keeps an identical scale and an upright cap-down stance on every screen, straight-on or at a slight 3/4 angle; the carton may sit beside it; nothing is ever clipped by the frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-minimal sensitive-skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool silver-white field #F1F3F6, deep cobalt accent #1F6FB2 and graphite-blue bars #16375C; cool neutral studio tone; modern geometric sans-serif with blanked label bars so no wording is ever rendered; one thin cobalt arc and one broad soft curved band as the only graphic devices; bright even high-key lighting from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card and soft contact shadows only; matte white acrylic, pale light-stone, pale marble and cool grey studio surfaces; thin single-weight line ring badges plus solid cobalt check circles with blank centres; stable upright product angle and identical product scale across every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no legible rendered wording, no real seals or badges.

shots.intent: 用纯白管体加一条膏体拖尾在搜索列表里赢下第一眼点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube upright cap-down, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key front-left softbox with white fill card, soft contact shadow only
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with one glossy cream ribbon sweeping behind the tube
shots.props: one swept ribbon of off-white #F4F2EF cream texture, nothing else
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, frame filled by tube and texture ribbon
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube stands cap-down and upright, straight-on at eye level with the whole silhouette visible and nothing clipped. Behind it one glossy ribbon of off-white #F4F2EF cream texture sweeps from the upper left to the lower right across a seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright even high-key light from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card, and a soft contact shadow under the cap so the tube reads grounded. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame and there is no extra whitespace. Negative: no brand marks, no legible label wording, no association seals or endorsement badges, no hands, no watermark, no floating product, no hard drop shadow, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心利益，右侧三枚勾选槽位承载可替换主张。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle for the tube, straight-on tight crop for the skin panel
shots.lighting: bright even front-left softbox key, soft contact shadow, natural skin texture
shots.background: cool silver-white field #F1F3F6 with one broad soft arc along the bottom edge
shots.props: three solid cobalt #1F6FB2 check circles with blank label bars
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top third reserved for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. At the right the tube stands at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a cool silver-white field #F1F3F6; at the left, an identity-free close crop of one cheek and jawline, cropped so the eye and mouth stay out of frame, with a small dab of off-white #F4F2EF cream being smoothed in by one fingertip. Three solid cobalt #1F6FB2 check circles stack beneath the crop, each paired with an empty label bar. Bright even front-left softbox light, soft contact shadow, natural skin texture with visible pores. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space across the top third reserved for copy that is not rendered. Negative: no recognizable face, no legible text, no invented efficacy claims, no plastic smoothed skin, no extra or fused fingers, no watermark, no fake logo, no second product.

shots.props: the carton beside the tube, plain tops on the figures, nothing covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space on the right half reserved for copy

shots.intent: 以侧脸局部演示膏体被推开的过程，证明清爽好吸收的观感。

shots.lighting: sweeping side light from the upper left skimming across the skin, soft shadow falloff
shots.background: warm-neutral skin field against a soft off-white #F3F0EC edge
shots.props: three empty thin-line cobalt #1F6FB2 ring badges stacked above blank bars
shots.whitespace: minimal extra whitespace, the smear is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product} in use. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile as a tight crop over one cheekbone and temple, the eye and mouth outside the frame so no identity reads, one fingertip pressing a translucent smear of off-white #F4F2EF cream into skin with real pores. Along the left edge three empty thin-line ring badges in deep cobalt #1F6FB2 stack vertically above blank bars. Sweeping side light from the upper left skimming across the surface shows how the film sinks in, with soft shadow falloff. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame and there is minimal extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no eyes, no legible wording, no invented claims, no retouched plastic skin, no missing or fused fingers, no watermark, no fake logo.

Filmed from a very low side angle with shallow depth of field and the front ridge in focus, soft light sweeping across the surface from the left so the peaks, gloss and micro-droplets read clearly over a pale light-stone field #E9E4DE. provenance.notes: 源图 9 张逐图事实：001 白底软管立姿配一条膏体拖尾；002 人物推涂局部加右侧三条勾选主张；003 左侧竖排三枚线稿圆徽加右侧侧脸推涂局部；004 软管斜置圆盘上，四周膏体与水珠，四角勾选主张；005 三位不同肤质人群叠肩同框，左下角管体与外盒；006 九枚圆形印章阵列排布主张；007 白卡密排双语说明与成分行加一枚机构徽章；008 三件不同器型产品横排加三步编号；009 家庭成员相拥群像。品类判定依据：主体为软管装面部用日常保湿乳，属护理清洁类而非着色彩妆，也无电器或器械成分，故归护肤个护／面部护理，leaf 按剂型与使用部位定名；源类目路径仅作检索线索，与看图判定一致。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、管身与白卡上的全部原文案（含双语说明段、使用说明与成分行）、机构徽章与专业背书字样（改空白圆框与空白参数行）、排他主张清单（改九格空框）、勾选条目与标题文字（改空标签条与空白 headline 槽）、人群与家庭的面容身份（一律改颈部以下、背影或颊侧等无身份局部）、编号流程字样与品牌历史年份（改空白编号条）、以及平台角标与星级类社会证明。产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用部分仅为分镜结构、机位、光位、背景体系与留白节奏。
